Remark
[Compact operators map weakly convergent to strongly convergent sequences] ↗ def:compact-linear-operator ↗ def:weak-convergence 1. appD:D.5-rem-1\group Fredholm Theory

If $H$ is a real Hilbert space, $K:H\to H$ is compact, and $u_k\rightharpoonup u$, then $Ku_k\to Ku$ strongly.
